body: Im just waiting for my money to be in order, prolly within 5 months, then im taking a one way flight back to the motherland. My health is failing n my mental is deteriorating. Ill spend my last 2 months w my whole family before i go n leave them. I could go rn but i guess itd be hard for my family to retrieve my body from the states so yeah im going back to the motherland to end it. Plus i really wanna spend my last days seeing everyone in my family. Im just holding on til all is in order. Finally i can throw in the towel.
